title: Missouri Attorney General Opinion No. 3-2025
text:
ATTORNEY GENERAL OF MISSOURI
ANDREW BAILEY
January 6, 2025
OPINION LETTER NO. 3-2025
The Honorable John R. Ashcroft
Missouri Secretary of State
James C. Kirkpatrick State Information Center
600 West Main Street
Jefferson City, MO 65101
Dear Secretary Ashcroft:
This opinion letter responds to your request dated December 26, 2024 for our
review under § 116.332, RSMo of the sufficiency as to form of an initiative petition
to amend Article III, of the Missouri Constitution submitted by Jamie Howard,
2026-016.
We approve the petition as to form, but § 116.332 gives the Secretary of State
final authority to approve or reject the petition. Therefore, our approval of the form
of the petition does not preclude you from rejecting the petition.
Because our review of the petition is simply for the purpose of determining
sufficiency as to form, the fact that we do not reject the petition is not to be
construed as a determination that the petition is sufficient as to substance.
Likewise, because our review is mandated by statute, no action that we take with
respect to such review should be construed as an endorsement of the petition or of
the objectives of its proponents, or the expression of any view respecting the
adequacy or inadequacy of the petition generally.
Very truly yours,
ANDREW BAILEY
Attorney General
